npc.example_merchant.greeting: [ZH_TW] Hello %s! Welcome to my shop. Say {trade} to see my offers.
npc.example_merchant.low_level: [ZH_TW] Sorry, but you are too inexperienced. Come back when you reach level 8.
npc.example_merchant.help: [ZH_TW] I can sell you potions, weapons and armor. Say {trade} to browse my goods.
npc.example_merchant.job: [ZH_TW] I am a merchant. I sell various goods to adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.name: [ZH_TW] My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
npc.example_merchant.trade: [ZH_TW] Of course! Here are my offers.
npc.example_merchant.news_1: [ZH_TW] Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
npc.example_merchant.news_2: [ZH_TW] The king is looking for brave adventurers.
